from __future__ import annotations

import json
import statistics
import time
from copy import deepcopy
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

from aspenops_nexus.models import EvaluationRequest, EvaluationResult
from aspenops_nexus.pool import CasePool


def request(value: float) -> EvaluationRequest:
    return EvaluationRequest.from_dict(
        {
            "model_path": "model.bkp",
            "registry_path": "registry.json",
            "backend": "mock",
            "writes": [{"key": "feed", "value": value}],
            "reads": [],
        }
    )


payload: dict[str, Any] = {
    "ok": True,
    "communication_ok": True,
    "engine_ok": True,
    "converged": True,
    "feasible": True,
    "values": {f"v{i}": float(i) for i in range(32)},
    "units": {f"v{i}": "1" for i in range(32)},
    "violations": [],
    "diagnostics": {"nested": {"values": list(range(64))}},
    "elapsed_s": 0.01,
    "balance_residuals": {},
    "cache_source": "computed",
    "cache_hit": False,
    "request_hash": "",
    "worker_id": 0,
}
duplicates = 1500
requests = [request(float(index)) for index in range(700)]
runtime = {
    "backend": "mock",
    "product": {"name": "mock", "version": "2.0", "features": list(range(64))},
    "nested": [{"index": index, "values": list(range(16))} for index in range(32)],
}
pool = object.__new__(CasePool)
pool.backend_name = "mock"
pool.model_sha256 = "m" * 64
pool.registry = SimpleNamespace(sha256="r" * 64)
pool._handles = [SimpleNamespace(runtime=runtime)]


def old_materialize() -> list[EvaluationResult]:
    return [EvaluationResult.from_dict(deepcopy(payload)) for _ in range(duplicates)]


def new_materialize() -> list[EvaluationResult]:
    template = EvaluationResult.from_dict(payload)
    return [template] + [deepcopy(template) for _ in range(duplicates - 1)]


def old_key_requests() -> list[tuple[str, EvaluationRequest]]:
    by_identity: dict[int, tuple[EvaluationRequest, str]] = {}
    keyed: list[tuple[str, EvaluationRequest]] = []
    for item in requests:
        identity = id(item)
        existing = by_identity.get(identity)
        if existing is not None and existing[0] is item:
            key = existing[1]
        else:
            key = pool.cache_key(item)
            by_identity[identity] = (item, key)
        keyed.append((key, item))
    return keyed


def measure(function: Any, repeats: int = 9) -> tuple[float, Any]:
    samples: list[float] = []
    result: Any = None
    for _ in range(repeats):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        result = function()
        samples.append(time.perf_counter() - started)
    return statistics.median(samples), result


old_materialize_s, old_results = measure(old_materialize)
new_materialize_s, new_results = measure(new_materialize)
old_key_s, old_keys = measure(old_key_requests)
new_key_s, new_keys = measure(lambda: pool._key_requests(requests))
checks = {
    "materialized_results_equal": [item.to_dict() for item in old_results]
    == [item.to_dict() for item in new_results],
    "cache_keys_equal": [item[0] for item in old_keys] == [item[0] for item in new_keys],
    "materialization_faster": new_materialize_s < old_materialize_s,
    "keying_faster": new_key_s < old_key_s,
}
result = {
    "schema": "aspenops.pool-efficiency-benchmark/v1",
    "boundary": "Pure Python orchestration benchmark; not licensed Aspen solve evidence.",
    "before_seconds": {
        "duplicate_cache_materialization": old_materialize_s,
        "batch_cache_keying": old_key_s,
    },
    "after_seconds": {
        "duplicate_cache_materialization": new_materialize_s,
        "batch_cache_keying": new_key_s,
    },
    "speedups": {
        "duplicate_cache_materialization": old_materialize_s / new_materialize_s,
        "batch_cache_keying": old_key_s / new_key_s,
    },
    "checks": checks,
    "decision": "PASS" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL",
}
with open("var/pool-efficiency-audit-files/benchmark.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(result, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    handle.write("\n")
if result["decision"] != "PASS":
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
